description:
About the Position

Bath Spa University invites applications for ESRC-funded PhD studentships through the South West Doctoral Training Partnership (SWDTP), with Bath Spa pathways in education, management and business, and sociotechnical futures. The internal Bath Spa application round closes at 11:59pm on 8 November 2026, ahead of the SWDTP final deadline of 12 January 2027, so candidates intending to nominate Bath Spa as their host should complete the university's research-degree application early.

ESRC studentships provide full tuition fees and an annual tax-free maintenance stipend at the UKRI doctoral rate, plus a research training support grant. Successful candidates join the SWDTP's doctoral training environment - a partnership of southwest English universities - with advanced methods training, cohort events and access to partnership-wide resources. Bath Spa supervisors work across education research, business and management studies, and interdisciplinary sociotechnical themes connecting technology, society and sustainability.

Candidate Profile and Application

Applicants hold an excellent undergraduate degree and normally a master's degree (or equivalent research experience) in a relevant social-science discipline, and must meet ESRC eligibility rules for UK fee status and residency. Applications are made through Bath Spa's research degrees application route, including a research proposal aligned with a SWDTP pathway, references and transcripts; the university's how-to-apply page sets out the exact documents and timeline.

Highlights

  • ESRC SWDTP funded PhD studentships at Bath Spa
  • Pathways: education, management and business, sociotechnical futures
  • Full fees plus UKRI-rate maintenance stipend
  • Internal deadline 8 November 2026, 11:59pm
  • SWDTP final round closes 12 January 2027
  • Doctoral training partnership methods programme

About Bath Spa University

Bath Spa University is a university in Bath, England, rooted in institutions dating back to 1852, with campuses including Newton Park and Corsham Court. It offers doctoral training across education, management and business, creative arts, humanities and social sciences, and is an active partner in the ESRC South West Doctoral Training Partnership (SWDTP) through which funded studentships are offered with partner universities. Research degrees at Bath Spa combine supervision by research-active staff with training in methods and professional development, and applications run through the university's research degrees admissions route.

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 8 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official page before the deadline: 8 November 2026, 11:59pm (internal deadline; SWDTP final round closes 12 January 2027). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents - early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
